| [Investment input pack](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Prepares the cost side of an OD business case and the investment input pack: one-time build, licences and hardware, recurring run cost and multi-year TCO for the minimum viable rollout and the maximum scale-out, each figure with a source or an open marker, the gates the spend must pass, and the open items. Use when a roadmap is agreed and the plant asks "what does this cost and who approves it", an equipment assessment lists machines that need hardware, a standardized system needs its cost template, or a capital request needs its cost side. Prepares input only; never approves or commits spend. Not for the value side (bc-build) or the request itself (bc-capital-request). |
